user_reported_bug:
Fix dati backend (seed.py + server.py). 3 punti, tutti causa-dati (la logica runtime è corretta):

1. seed.py — i tavoli sono creati senza campo position, quindi ereditano il default Position(0,0) di models.py e in planimetria si impilano nell'angolo. Assegna a ogni tavolo una position su griglia distinta dentro la sua area (passo ~120px, a capo ogni 4 tavoli).

2. seed.py — le prenotazioni demo sono inserite direttamente nel DB senza chiamare _recompute_customer_metrics, quindi clienti come 'Andrea Verdi' restano con total_bookings=0. Dopo l'insert delle prenotazioni demo, chiama _recompute_customer_metrics per ogni cliente coinvolto.

3. server.py — aggiungi una funzione di riparazione idempotente eseguita UNA volta all'avvio che, sul DB esistente: (a) riposiziona su griglia i tavoli ancora a position (0,0); (b) esegue _recompute_customer_metrics per tutti i clienti; (c) elimina i clienti con name che inizia per 'TEST_'.

Accettazione: planimetria senza tavoli impilati; Totale di ogni scheda cliente coerente con lo storico; nessun cliente TEST_; riparazione ri-eseguibile senza duplicati.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Backend-only verification used owner API plus direct Mongo setup/reset. Fresh auto-seed, seeded customer metrics, TEST_ cleanup, basic repair, and two-restart idempotency passed. Verdict is not_fixed because startup repair can still leave stacked tables: when an existing manually positioned table already occupies a future grid slot, a stuck (0,0) table is moved onto that same occupied slot.

critical.issue: Repair positions stuck tables using placed_count + idx instead of scanning occupied grid slots. Reproduction: fresh seed, create table QA_MANUAL_SLOT8 in Sala Principale at {x:40,y:240}, create QA_STUCK_COLLISION at default {0,0}, restart backend. GET /api/tables then returns both QA_MANUAL_SLOT8 and QA_STUCK_COLLISION at {x:40,y:240} in the same area, so planimetria can still have stacked tables.

action_items: In server.py _repair_data, for each area build a set of occupied non-zero positions and assign each stuck table to the next unoccupied grid coordinate; do not rely on placed_count + idx.
Rerun the iteration 5 backend data-repair test, including the manual future-grid-slot collision case.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py lines 1252-1261: placed_count only counts non-zero tables; it does not know which grid slots are already occupied. If a manually placed table occupies slot N while earlier slot(s) are free, the next stuck table can be assigned to the occupied slot N, creating an overlap.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA_STUCK_BASIC, TEST_DELETE_ME_ITER5, AUDIT_TEST_Comet, test_lower_case_iter5, QA_MANUAL_SLOT8, and QA_STUCK_COLLISION records during testing. The script then dropped and re-seeded the demo tenant as final cleanup; current demo data is fresh seed state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh seed and normal idempotency passed: 11 tables, 4 seeded customers, Andrea Verdi total_bookings=1, no TEST_ customers. The remaining failure is the repair edge case where an occupied future grid slot is not skipped; see raw report collision_edge failures.
rca_of_the_issue: The repair algorithm offsets by the count of already placed tables, assuming occupied grid slots are contiguous from slot 0. Existing/manual positions can be sparse, so the computed slot may already be occupied. Mitigation: compute occupied grid coordinates per area and iterate slot indexes until an unused coordinate is found for each stuck table. No mocked APIs were used.
